## Gráfica FMP y FDA: Binomial (n=3, p=0.4)

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 5
par(mfrow = c(1, 2), mar = c(4, 4, 3, 1))

x  <- 0:3
px <- dbinom(x, 3, 0.4)
Fx <- pbinom(x, 3, 0.4)

# FMP
bp <- barplot(px, names.arg = x,
              col = c("#bfdbfe","#3b82f6","#3b82f6","#bfdbfe"),
              border = NA,
              main = "FMP: P(X = x)",
              xlab = "x", ylab = "P(X = x)",
              ylim = c(0, 0.55), cex.lab = 1.3, cex.main = 1.4)
text(bp, px + 0.02, round(px, 3), cex = 1.2, font = 2)

# FDA
plot(stepfun(x, c(0, Fx)),
     do.points = TRUE, pch = 19, col = "#1b4d2e", lwd = 2,
     main = "FDA: F(x) = P(X ≤ x)",
     xlab = "x", ylab = "F(x)",
     xlim = c(-0.5, 3.8), ylim = c(0, 1.05),
     cex.lab = 1.3, cex.main = 1.4, verticals = TRUE)
points(x, Fx, pch = 1, col = "#1b4d2e", cex = 1.4, lwd = 2)
text(x + 0.15, Fx + 0.04, round(Fx, 3), cex = 1.1, col = "#1b4d2e", font = 2)
```
